sites.name: Jezero Crater · Three Forks EVA
sites.info: Ancient river delta explored by Perseverance. This map plans a walk from the flat Three Forks sample depot up to the delta front along ground the rover has already driven.

sites.name: Jezero Crater · full Perseverance traverse
sites.info: 45 km driven from the Octavia E. Butler landing site (18.4446°N, 77.4509°E) across the crater floor, the delta and up the crater rim, sols 13–2022.

sites.name: Gale Crater · Curiosity
sites.info: Bradbury Landing (4.5895°S, 137.4417°E). Curiosity's RAD instrument measured the surface radiation used in this planner. Only global layers are loaded here.

sites.name: Utopia Planitia · Viking 2 / SHARAD ice
sites.info: Viking 2 landed here (47.64°N, 225.71°W). MRO's SHARAD radar found a buried ice-rich deposit in Utopia Planitia; whether a crew could reach it is not demonstrated.
